references.text: Moses was commanded by the Lord to teach the people statutes and laws that they were to keep in the land they were about to enter.
The Lord commanded Moses to teach the Israelites commands, statutes, and laws that they were to keep in the land they were to take possession of.
The people were to keep the statutes and laws when they entered the land on the other side of the Jordan that they were to occupy.
Statutes and laws that the Israelites were to keep in the land the Lord gave them as their possession.
Statutes, laws, and instructions that the Lord gave between himself and the children of Israel through Moses at Mount Sinai.
The Lord commanded Moses to present laws and statutes to the people.
The Israelites were commanded to take possession of the land and settle there, for the Lord had given them the land as their possession.
The Israelites were to cross the Jordan and take possession of the land that the Lord their God gave them as their possession.
Jesus commanded his disciples to teach all nations to keep everything he had commanded them, just as Moses was commanded to teach the Israelites God's commands.
